item.title: In Yo-han "Regrets Martial Law Remarks"...President Lee's 'Red Cross President Approval' in Focus (인요한 “계엄 발언 반성”에…이 대통령 ‘적십자 회장 인준’ 촉각)
item.description:
Controversy continues over the election of In Yo-han, former People Power Party lawmaker who defended the December 3 martial law, as president of the Korean Red Cross. In, who previously said he "understands from the heart" former President Yoon Seok-yeol during the martial law, has since repeatedly humbled himself after being elected, stating, "I regret not opposing the martial law and I am reflecting." President Lee Jae-myung is expected to decide on final approval based on public opinion trends. <<> In a statement to The Hankyoreh on the 24th, former lawmaker In said, "I expressed my stance on the martial law through my actions," adding, "I resigned from my parliamentary seat because I thought the martial law was wrong." He did not participate in the early morning vote to lift the martial law at the National Assembly on December 4, 2024, and also expressed opposition during the vote on the impeachment motion against former President Yoon. However, after announcing his resignation from his parliamentary seat last December, he stated, "Considering what has come to light in the year since the martial law, I am disappointed and feel it is disgraceful." Following his election as the new president of the Korean Red Cross on the 22nd through a vote by the Central Committee, he released a statement saying, "Instead of a thousand words about the damage to constitutional order and the national misfortune caused by the illegal martial law, I practiced my conviction through a single action: resigning my parliamentary seat." <<> Nevertheless, criticism of In's election as president continued on the same day from both sides of the aisle. Park Ji-won, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, said on CBS Radio, "He should have apologized to the people for defending the insurrection forces and being at the forefront." A senior Democratic Party lawmaker with multiple terms commented, "It's hard to readily agree to appoint someone with views inconsistent with the government's stance as president." Even within the People Power Party, Han Ji-a, a lawmaker, pointed out, "At the very least, he should offer a clear apology to the people." The Rebuilding Korea Party and the Progressive Party have stated that President Lee should reject the approval. <<> According to the Korean Red Cross Organization Act, the president is elected by a vote of 28 Central Committee members, including 19 civilian members, and is ultimately approved by the President, who serves as honorary chairman. The Central Committee includes ministers from eight ministries, including the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety. This is why In's election is seen as reflecting President Lee's intentions. A source within the ruling party said, "While the focus on a unifying figure is appropriate, he needs to make a gesture of self-justification and seek understanding from the public," adding that it is difficult to predict the approval outcome. <<> In the healthcare sector, In is being criticized for his advocacy of medical privatization. Na Baek-ju, a professor of preventive medicine at Eulji University School of Medicine, pointed out, "It is inappropriate for someone who has argued against strengthening public healthcare—where profitability is hard to guarantee—to take a position that requires policy will to enhance it." The Health and Medical Workers' Union plans to hold an emergency press conference in front of the Presidential Office on the 25th to urge the denial of approval. <<> By Seo Young-ji, Shin So-yoon, Ko Han-sol, and Jo Hee-yeon, reporters yj@hani.co.kr (12·3 비상계엄을 옹호한 인요한 전 국민의힘 의원이 대한적십자사 회장으로 선출된 데 대한 논란이 가라앉지 않고 있다. 비상계엄 당시 윤석열 전 대통령을 “가슴으로 이해한다”고 말했던 그는 회장 선출 뒤 “계엄을 반대하지 않은 게 후회스럽고, 반성한다”고 거듭 몸을 낮췄다. 이재명 대통령은 여론 추이를 보고 최종 인준 여부를 결정할 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: Returning Jang Dong-hyuk Dismisses Calls for Resignation...Oh Se-hoon "Is a Party Leader Really Necessary?" (복귀한 장동혁 사퇴 요구 일축…오세훈 “당대표 굳이 필요한가”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, was discharged from the hospital on the 24th and reiterated his dismissal of demands for his resignation, stating, "The fate of the party leader is a matter for the party members to decide." Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon raised a "party leader uselessness theory," saying, "I’m not sure if a party leader is really necessary." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 24일 퇴원해 “당 대표의 거취는 당원들이 결정할 문제”라며 사퇴 요구를 거듭 일축했다. 오세훈 서울시장은 “굳이 당대표가 필요한지 모르겠다”고 ‘당대표 무용론’을 제기했다.)

Jang, who had been hospitalized on the 18th and was discharged after six days, held a press conference at the National Assembly on the same afternoon, saying, "The fate of the party leader is not something to be decided arbitrarily by the party leader, and even less so by a few lawmakers. Now is not the time to be fighting among ourselves over such matters." He added, "What party members truly want is for us to unite tightly to stop the rampage of the Lee Jae-myung regime and protect the nation and its people. Renewing the party and establishing discipline are tasks that can no longer be postponed." He further emphasized, "Now is the time to focus on the special counsel for the restoration of voting rights. We must pool our efforts for the by-elections." (지난 18일 입원했다가 엿새 만에 퇴원한 장 대표는 이날 오후 국회에서 복귀 기자회견을 열어 “당대표 거취는 당대표 마음대로 결정할 수 있는 문제가 아니고, 몇몇 의원이 결정할 문제는 더 아니다”며 “지금은 그런 일로 우리끼리 싸울 때가 결코 아니다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “당원들이 진정 원하는 것은 이재명 정권의 폭주를 멈춰 세우고 나라와 국민을 지키기 위해 하나로 똘똘 뭉치라는 것”이라며 “당을 쇄신하고 기강을 확립하는 일은 더 이상 미룰 수 없는 과제”라고 했다. 이어 “지금은 참정권 회복 특검에 집중해야 할 때”라며 “지금은 재선거에 힘을 모아야 한다”고 강조했다.)

Jang also strongly criticized President Lee Jae-myung. Referring to the court’s decision to convict Lee Hwa-young, former Vice Governor of Gyeonggi Province, for perjury regarding the "salmon drinking party" testimony, he argued, "The withdrawal of the indictment that Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party dreamed of has become completely impossible. If they don’t give up on withdrawing the indictment, the only path for President Lee is impeachment." (장 대표는 이재명 대통령도 맹비난했다. 그는 법원이 이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사의 ‘연어 술파티’ 진술을 위증이라고 판단하고 유죄 판결을 내린 점을 언급하며 “이재명과 민주당이 꿈꿨던 공소 취소는 아예 물 건너갔다. 공소취소를 포기하지 않는다면 이 대통령이 가야할 길은 탄핵 뿐”이라고 주장했다.)

Amid this, Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon raised the "party leader uselessness theory." (이런 가운데 오세훈 서울시장은 ‘당 대표 무용론’을 제기했다.)

Speaking as a lecturer at a seminar of the Future Innovation Forum, a research group primarily composed of People Power Party lawmakers, Mayor Oh stated, "The party leader gets involved in every social phenomenon, turning political strife into routine. Is a party leader really necessary? The party can be sufficiently run by the floor leader." He added, "Isn’t the U.S. case an example of a parliamentary party? If abolishing the party leader is practically impossible, we need to shift toward a parliamentary-centered party." Regarding the calls for Jang’s resignation, Oh said, "There’s no need to shed blood over this. It’s at a stage where a consensus among lawmakers is slowly forming from the ground up," indicating that it’s "a matter of time." (오 시장은 국민의힘 의원들 주축의 연구모임인 미래혁신포럼 세미나에 강연자로 나서 “모든 사회 현상에 당 대표가 관여해서 정쟁이 일상화돼 있다”며 “굳이 당 대표가 필요한가. 원내대표로 충분히 당이 운영된다”고 했다. 그는 “미국 같은 경우가 원내 정당이지 않느냐”며 “(당 대표 폐지가) 현실적으로 불가능하다면 원내 중심 정당으로 바뀌어야 한다”고 말했다. 오 시장은 장 대표 사퇴론에 대해서는 “굳이 피를 흘려가면서 할 필요가 없다. 의원들의 총의가 바닥부터 꿈틀꿈틀 형성되는 단계다”며 ‘시간 문제’라는 인식을 나타냈다.)

Floor Leader Jung Jeom-sik had lunch with four-term lawmakers within the party on the same day, gathering opinions on Jang’s departure. A participant told The Hankyoreh, "There were calls for Jang’s resignation, as well as opinions that the floor leader lacks the authority to decide, which could create unnecessary controversy." On the 16th, Jung had lunch with five-term lawmakers. He has indicated his intention to gather lawmakers’ opinions and bring an early end to the controversy over Jang’s resignation. Pro-Yoon faction lawmaker Park Jung-hoon criticized on Facebook, "If you refuse to resign, at least seek a vote of confidence from the party members." (정점식 원내대표는 이날 당내 4선 의원들과 오찬을 하며 장 대표 퇴진과 관련한 의견 등을 수렴했다. 한 참석자는 한겨레에 “장 대표 사퇴론도 나왔고, 원내대표가 결정 권한이 없는데 불필요한 논란만 만들 수 있다는 의견도 있었다”고 전했다. 정 원내대표는 지난 16일에는 5선 의원들과 오찬을 했다. 그는 의원들의 뜻을 모아 장 대표 사퇴 논란을 조기 종결하겠다는 뜻을 밝혀 왔다. 친한계인 박정훈 의원은 페이스북에 “사퇴를 거부하려면 적어도 당원들에게 재신임이라도 물으라”고 비판했다.)

item.title: Board of Audit and Inspection to Launch 'Accounting Audit' of Election Commission… Likely to Review Sole-Source Contracts and Budget Management (감사원, 선관위에 ‘회계 검사’ 들어간다…수의계약·예산 운용 볼 듯)
item.description:
The Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) has decided to commence an accounting audit of the National Election Commission (NEC), which caused a shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections. (감사원이 6·3 지방선거에서 투표용지 부족 사태를 일으킨 중앙선거관리위원회(선관위)에 대한 회계 검사에 착수하기로 했다.)

BAI Chairman Kim Ho-cheol stated at a press conference held at the BAI headquarters in Jongno-gu, Seoul on the 24th, "There is immense public interest and concern over the unacceptable violation of voting rights in the election," adding, "Following a resolution by the Audit Committee yesterday (the 23rd), we have begun collecting data for the accounting audit today." He further mentioned, "After data collection, we will determine the scope and duration of the audit and select items for inspection. We anticipate conducting on-site audits around July." (김호철 감사원장은 24일 서울 종로구 감사원 청사에서 연 기자간담회에서 “납득할 수 없는 선거에서의 참정권 침해 사태에 대해 국민들의 지대한 관심이 있고 우려가 높은 상황”이라며 “(지난 23일) 감사위원회의 의결을 거쳐 오늘 회계 검사를 위한 자료 수집에 나섰다”고 말했다. 이어 “자료 수집을 해서 검사 범위와 기간을 정하고, 검사 사항을 선정하는 대로 대략 7월 정도에는 실지 감사(현장 조사)에 나설 것으로 예상한다”고 말했다.)

In February of last year, the Constitutional Court ruled that the BAI cannot conduct job audits on the NEC, an independent constitutional institution. Consequently, the BAI has decided to examine the NEC's issues through accounting audits instead of job audits. Job audits involve verifying the performance of public officials' duties, while accounting audits review an institution's budget management, asset handling, and other processes. Chairman Kim explained, "While we cannot conduct job audits on the NEC, accounting audits of constitutional institutions are our constitutional and legal duty under the BAI Act," adding, "We will focus on matters related to the ballot shortage, but to resolve public doubts, we must examine all related issues." (지난해 2월 헌법재판소는 감사원이 독립적 헌법기관인 선관위의 직무 감찰을 할 수 없다고 결정했다. 감사원은 이에 직무 감찰 대신 회계 검사 방식으로 선관위 문제를 들여다보기로 한 것이다. 직무 감찰은 공무원의 직무 수행을 확인하는 것이고, 회계 검사는 기관의 예산 운용, 물품 관리 등을 살펴보는 절차다. 김 원장은 “선관위의 직무 감찰은 할 수 없는 상황이지만, 헌법기관에 대한 회계 검사는 저희에게 주어진 헌법상·감사원법상의 책무”라며 “투표용지 부족 사태와 관련 있는 사항을 중점적으로 보겠지만, 그와 연관돼 살펴볼 수 있는 사항은 다 살펴봐야 국민의 의혹이 해소될 것”이라고 말했다.)

The BAI is expected to thoroughly review the NEC's budget planning and execution, contract management, acquisition, management, and preservation of assets, as well as accounting procedures. Since budget plans and execution for ballot papers, contractual relationships between the NEC and election supply vendors, and the accounting work of NEC staff can all be examined within the framework of an accounting audit, it is believed that the issues can be clarified. (감사원은 구체적으로 선관위 예산 편성·운용과 계약 관리, 물품의 취득·관리·보존과 회계 처리 업무 과정을 두루 살펴볼 전망이다. 투표용지 관련 예산 계획과 운용 과정, 선관위와 선거용품 관련 납품 업체들 간의 계약 관계, 선관위 직원들의 회계 처리 업무 수행은 모두 회계 검사의 틀 안에서 살펴볼 수 있기 때문에 문제 규명이 가능하다고 보는 것이다.)

There is also a possibility that the BAI will look into allegations of the NEC's "split sole-source contracts with specific companies." Chairman Kim noted, "Contract management is related to budget planning and execution," and "Issues with sole-source contracts have been pointed out in previous accounting audits, so we will examine them this time as well." During the National Assembly's special committee for the parliamentary inspection of the NEC, allegations arose that the top five companies with sole-source contracts with the NEC received half of the total sole-source contract amount, indicating a concentration issue. (선관위의 ‘특정 업체 쪼개기 수의계약’ 의혹도 살펴볼 가능성이 있다. 김 원장은 “계약 관리는 예산의 편성, 집행과 관련한 부분”이라며 “(기존) 회계 검사에서도 수의계약 문제는 지적돼온 부분이라 (이번에도) 살펴보게 될 것”이라고 말했다. 국회 선관위 국정조사 특별위원회에서는 선관위와 수의계약한 상위 5개 업체가 수의계약 금액의 절반을 받는 등 쏠림 현상이 나타났다는 의혹이 제기됐다.)

Responding to calls from political circles to amend the BAI Act to include the NEC under the BAI's job audit authority, Chairman Kim expressed, "Some issues cannot be resolved simply by amending the BAI Act," and "To conduct audits differently from the Constitutional Court's decision, a constitutional amendment would be necessary." (김 원장은 다만 선관위를 감사원 직무 감찰 대상에 포함시키는 방향으로 감사원법을 개정해야 한다는 정치권의 입장에 대해선 “감사원법 개정으론 해소가 어려운 부분이 있다”며 “헌재 결정과 다르게 감사를 운영하려면, 헌법 개정이 이뤄져야 한다”고 의견을 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, the joint investigation team of prosecutors and police, which is probing the ballot shortage incident, conducted a search and seizure of 12 NEC officials on the same day. The team stated, "To thoroughly reconstruct the situation of the ballot shortage on election day, we executed search and seizure warrants for three officials from the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission and nine from the Songpa District Election Commission." (한편, 투표용지 부족 사태를 수사 중인 검경 합동수사본부는 이날 선관위 관계자 12명을 압수수색했다. 합수본은 이날 “선거일 투표용지 부족 상황에 대한 면밀한 재구성을 위해 서울시 선관위 관계자 3명과 송파구 선관위 관계자 9명에 대한 압수수색을 실시했다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporters Jang Ye-ji and Kim Ji-eun at penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 김지은 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government Confirms Female Firefighter Was Forced to Drink and Run Errands…Demands Disciplinary Action for 17 (정부, 여성 소방관에 ‘음주·심부름 강요’ 확인…17명 징계 요구)
item.description:
A female firefighter in her 20s, who took her own life last October, has been found to have been forced to attend late-night drinking sessions and consume alcohol at work, and to have carried out personal errands for colleagues during family events. The fire station involved had the perpetrator of this abuse serve as the head of the inspection department, who closed the case as having "no irregularities." (지난해 10월 스스로 목숨을 끊은 20대 여성 소방관이 직장에서 심야 술자리 참석과 음주를 강요받고, 경조사에서 사적인 심부름을 했던 것으로 확인됐다. 해당 소방서는 갑질 가해자가 감찰부서장을 맡아 이 사건을 ‘특이사항 없음’으로 종결했다.)

On the 24th, the government's Joint Public Service Inspection Team under the Office for Government Policy Coordination announced the results of an intensive two-week inspection, starting from the 11th, into the death of the firefighter, targeting the National Fire Agency, the Gwangju Fire Safety Headquarters, and Gwangsan Fire Station. (24일 국무조정실 정부합동 공직복무점검단은 지난 11일부터 2주 동안 소방청과 광주소방안전본부, 광산소방서를 대상으로 소방관 사망사건을 집중 점검한 결과를 발표했다.)

The investigation revealed that the victim attended drinking sessions a total of 24 times over 15 months from July 2024 at the Gwangsan Fire Station where she worked. Some of these sessions extended into the late night at nightclubs or karaoke rooms. Superiors forced the victim to sit next to male supervisors such as the station chief and department heads, and some superiors told her to "comfortably call them older brother." The victim was also forced to prepare for retirement ceremonies on weekends, run errands during the former station chief's father's and father-in-law's funerals, and drive vehicles for senior staff transfers. Superiors also demanded that the victim buy alcohol or coffee for them when she traveled abroad. Ultimately, unable to endure this, the victim died last October. (조사 결과 피해자는 근무했던 광산소방서에서 2024년 7월부터 15개월 동안 모두 24차례 술자리에 참석한 것으로 나타났다. 일부 술자리는 나이트클럽이나 노래방 등에서 심야까지 이어졌다. 상사들은 피해자에게 서장, 과장 등 남성 상사 옆자리에 앉도록 강요했고, 일부 상사들은 ‘편하게 오빠라고 부르라’고 하기도 했다. 피해자는 주말에도 서장 등의 퇴임식 행사 준비, 전임 서장 부친상·장인상에서의 심부름, 상급자 이동을 위한 차량 운행도 강요 당했다. 상사들은 국외여행을 가는 피해자에게 술이나 커피 등을 사 오라고 요구하기도 했다. 결국 피해자는 이를 견디지 못하고 지난해 10월 숨졌다.)

After the victim's death, it was found that Gwangsan Fire Station, the Gwangju Fire Safety Headquarters, and the National Fire Agency headquarters effectively ignored the family's requests for an inspection. Notably, at Gwangsan Fire Station, the department head who was the perpetrator of workplace harassment conducted a "self-investigation" and closed the case as having "no irregularities." The Gwangju Fire Safety Headquarters delayed the investigation under the pretext of needing evidence submissions regarding concerns raised by the victim's boyfriend, and later distorted the issue by writing in the report that the cause of the victim's death was a conflict with her boyfriend. (피해자가 숨진 뒤 광산소방서와 광주소방안전본부, 소방청 본청은 유족들의 감찰 요구를 사실상 묵살한 것으로 나타났다. 특히, 광산소방서는 직장내 괴롭힘 가해자인 부서장이 사건을 ‘셀프 조사’하면서 ‘특이사항 없음’으로 종결했다. 광주소방안전본부는 피해자 남자친구의 문제제기에 대해 자료 증빙을 핑계로 조사를 미뤘고, 이후 보고서에 피해자의 사망 원인이 남자 친구와의 불화인 것처럼 써 사안을 왜곡했다.)

President Lee Jae-myung said during a cabinet meeting on the 23rd that he had asked the Office for Government Policy Coordination to investigate this case, calling it "the worst kind of abuse of power." (이재명 대통령은 지난 23일 국무회의에서 국무조정실에 이 사건을 조사해보라고 했다며 “최악의 갑질”이라고 말했다.)

The Office for Government Policy Coordination announced plans to demand disciplinary action from the National Fire Agency against a total of 17 individuals—9 from Gwangsan Fire Station, 6 from Gwangju Fire Safety Headquarters, and 2 from the National Fire Agency headquarters—where misconduct was confirmed, and to request an investigation into 2 retirees who had managerial responsibility for the misconduct. (국무조정실은 비위 행위가 확인된 광산소방서 9명, 광주소방안전본부 6명, 소방청 본청 2명 등 총 17명에 대한 징계처분을 소방청에 요구하고, 비위 행위에 관리 책임이 있는 퇴직자 2명에 대해서는 수사 의뢰할 계획이라고 발표했다.)

Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)
